blocks.text: Experience the best of Brazil with a seamless blend of iconic city sights and coastal luxury. Begin in vibrant Rio de Janeiro, taking in breathtaking panoramas from Sugar Loaf and standing before the legendary Christ the Redeemer. After soaking up the city’s lively culture and sun-kissed beaches, escape to the glamorous peninsula of Búzios, with its crystal-clear water, golden beaches and charming cobbled streets lined with boutique dining: the ultimate Brazilian getaway for pure relaxation.
